_doc: T4's fixtures (HARNESS-PLAN.md section 3, upstream.py: upstream's 2019 tutorial-1 .gabe files and oracle.json become fixtures). Copied on 2026-10-01 from the main checkout's gitignored target/. The three GABE files are byte copies (binary: git does not convert them). oracle.json is text and is kept with LF, as this folder keeps text (../../.gitattributes): sha256 is the file as committed, source_sha256 the CRLF original. tests/test_upstream.py pins the same hashes.

Sound level.recp.what: the receiver's per-band energy series that upstream's GUI read (uphunt_oracle.py:14); the port's input

Acoustic parameters.gabe.what: upstream's own EDT (s) column, written by its GUI on the upstream author's machine in 2019

Schroeder curves.gabe.what: upstream's Schroeder curves for the same receiver (uphunt_oracle.py:29-43)

oracle.json.what: uphunt_oracle.py's record: for 'EDT (s)', 29 rows (27 bands, Global, Average), each with upstream's value and the port's; 24 of 29 bit-identical, max relative difference 6.0e-6
